reviews.feedback: internal/api/subscriptions.go:78-84: updateSubscription now returns 200 whenever Update returns an error with a non-empty sub.ID. For an upgrade, Update has already committed the plan change before prorate runs, so a non-decline failure (CreateInvoice error, or a non-decline error from charge in subscriptions.go prorate/charge) yields an upgraded subscription with no prorated invoice and a success response; the error is only logged. Fix this so an upgrade cannot be applied without its invoice: create the prorated invoice before committing the subscription update, or on a prorate error revert the change and return the error through subError/payError. Either way the caller must see the failure. Add a test where the gateway returns a non-decline error on an upgrade and assert that the plan is unchanged or the error is returned. Optional: Update reads cur outside the store update, so concurrent PATCHes can be classified against stale state.
